theme.subheader: Choose between the light and dark appearance for the whole application.

commander.subheader: It enables users to quickly search, navigate, and execute actions through a keyboard-driven interface, triggered by shortcuts like Ctrl + K

update.subheader: Here you can update configurations for User Interface, like menu, commander, connection editor.

customTheme.title: Custom theme
customTheme.description: Pick your four main colors — primary, accent, neutral tone and sidebar. A full light and dark theme is generated from them and applied for every user; anyone who picked a theme of their own keeps it.

systemTheme.saved: System theme saved for all users
systemTheme.saveFailed: The system theme could not be saved
systemTheme.resetFailed: The system theme could not be reset
systemTheme.personalOverride: You are viewing a theme of your own, which hides the system theme on this screen. Other users still see the system theme.

confirmReset.title: Reset system theme?
confirmReset.message: The saved colors are deleted and every user falls back to the default theme. Users with a theme of their own are not affected.

systemLogo.title: Application logo
systemLogo.description: Replace the OpenCelium logo with your own for every user. It is shown in the navigation menu and on the login screen, so users see it before they sign in.
systemLogo.hint: PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB. A wide logo on a transparent background works best — the same file is shown on both the light and the dark theme.
systemLogo.usingDefault: No logo uploaded — every user sees the default OpenCelium logo.
systemLogo.saveFailed: The logo could not be uploaded
systemLogo.removeFailed: The logo could not be reset
systemLogo.invalidType: The logo must be a PNG or JPG file
systemLogo.tooLarge: The logo must be smaller than 5 MB

confirmRemove.title: Reset to the default logo?
confirmRemove.message: The uploaded logo is deleted and every user sees the OpenCelium logo again.

crop.title: Crop logo
crop.instruction: Move the frame to trim the area around your logo
